documentMetadata.title: Computer Networks Question Bank 2026 - Comprehensive Set
documentMetadata.subject: Computer Networks
documentMetadata.description: Comprehensive question bank covering OSI & TCP/IP Reference Models, Data Link Layer, Sliding Window Protocols, Network Layer IP Addressing & Subnetting, Routing Algorithms, Transport Layer TCP/UDP & Congestion Control, and Application Layer Protocols.

questions.question: Compare the 7-Layer OSI Reference Model with the 4-Layer TCP/IP Protocol Suite, detailing the functions and protocols of each layer.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain transmission media characteristics: Twisted Pair, Coaxial Cable, and Optical Fiber, along with Guided vs Unguided transmission.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain Sliding Window Flow Control protocols: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N (GBN) ARQ, and Selective Repeat (SR) ARQ with sender/receiver window sizes.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Describe Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) error detection technique with an example of polynomial division for given data bitstream and generator polynomial.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain CSMA/CD (Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Detection) and CSMA/CA protocol mechanisms and backoff algorithm.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Given an IPv4 address block 192.168.10.0/24, design a subnetting scheme to support 4 subnets with specific host requirements using Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM).
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain Distance Vector Routing Algorithm using Bellman-Ford algorithm and discuss the Count-to-Infinity problem along with its solutions.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Describe Link State Routing Algorithm and compute shortest paths for a given network topology using Dijkstra's Algorithm.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain TCP 3-Way Handshake Connection Establishment and 4-Way Connection Termination with sequence numbers and flags (SYN, ACK, FIN).
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Differentiate between TCP and UDP in terms of header format, connection state, reliability, and use-case applications.
questions.subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Explain TCP Congestion Control mechanisms: Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, and Fast Recovery (AIMD).
questions.subject: Computer Networks
